tonight.headline: Favoured, but the tight end is limited
body: Week 4 hasn't started. ESPN has you at 124.2 against Team 13's 112.3, 56%. The bad news: Kenyon Sadiq was limited in Wednesday's practice with an undisclosed injury, ESPN now lists him questionable, and there is no other tight end on the roster.
Nothing to do today. The lineup as set is the projection lineup (you already moved Downs into the flex). If Sadiq is ruled out, the plan is a free-agent tight end, not a claim.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Team 13 start Josh Allen, who practised without issue Wednesday (CBS). Lamar Jackson, on their bench, was limited with a back issue Minter calls 'something small'.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Sadiq DNP on Thursday or Friday: then the Andrews card below fires.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · if Sadiq is ruled out Friday or inactive at Sun 09:30 Mexico City
doFirst.title: If Sadiq sits: add Mark Andrews, drop Carnell Tate
doFirst.subtitle: No tight end on the bench, so the fallback lives on the wire. Free after Thu 01:00: no priority.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Sadiq was limited Wednesday; RotoWire can't say whether it's new or tied to his offseason hernia surgery (30 Sep). The Jets list him with Ruckert and Fitzpatrick as limited (NewYorkJets.com). ESPN: QUESTIONABLE at 9.9.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Andrews projects 10.1 at home to Tennessee, who are last in plays per game (4for4). Zay Flowers was limited and Minter says he's 'ready to push to be back closer to full time' (BaltimoreRavens.com 30 Sep), so Andrews' target share may shrink. He's on waivers until Thu 01:00 and a free agent after: add, don't claim, because a claim costs never-resetting priority from 8th.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Carnell Tate, the fifth receiver: 11.9 and behind Wilson, Rice, Downs and Golden. Not on the screen's exposure list; Kamara and Gordon are, so they are not drops.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It fires and Andrews scores less than the best free tight end that week (Hunter Henry, Loveland).

whatWentWrong.title: One tight end, and he's limited
whatWentWrong.lead: The TE seat changed hands three times in a week and ended with a single rookie who's now questionable. No bench player can cover the slot.

case.label: The tool
case.body: lineup_check.py: 'NOBODY ELIGIBLE on the bench — find one on the wire in his TE slot.' That's the Andrews card.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Sadiq full on Friday: then nothing fires.

whatWentWrong.title: Priority is 8th, so every fallback has to be free
whatWentWrong.lead: Carried: Gordon was claimed overnight with never-resetting priority. Andrews works because he clears to free agency Thursday.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Wait for Thu 01:00 before adding Andrews. Before then it's a claim.
